gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that tag lookup is case-insensitive, both via the static Tag.valueOf and via the TagSet instance method, regardless of the active JVM locale.
ADDED i2: Static Tag.valueOf should treat "script" and "SCRIPT" as equal tags
ADDED i3: TagSet.valueOf returns the same cached Tag instance for any case variant
ADDED i4: Verifies that standard HTML tags are recognized as known, while invented tag names are not.
